name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx as a multi-site static web server for three SSL-enabled cluster-local domains, including security hardening, firewall rules, Fail2ban, SSH restrictions, generated certificates, document roots, and static test content.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis on port 6379 with authentication and logging, creates its runtime directory, and applies a compatibility workaround to the generated configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI application from GitHub, installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, creates a virtual environment and database, writes the application environment file, and runs Uvicorn as a systemd service on port 8000.
